speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have generalized fatigue, pallor, and abnormal blood findings. To begin our evaluation, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 67-year-old male. The patient complains of a 2-month history of generalized fatigue. He mentions no specific triggers but notes that the fatigue has been progressively worsening. He denies any recent infections, significant weight loss, or night sweats.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Iron Deficiency Anemia secondary to occult gastrointestinal bleeding.

Given your age and progressive fatigue over two months, have you noticed any black, tarry stools, blood in your stool, or difficulty swallowing food? I will also need to see your complete blood count and iron studies to confirm.
